description: This Java class defines an AttachmentService for handling file uploads, listing, and downloading attachments associated with emails. It manages file storage on disk and metadata in the database, providing methods for uploading files, listing attachments by email, and loading attachments for download.

classes.name: AttachmentService
classes.description: Service for managing the upload, listing, and downloading of email attachments, persisting files on disk and metadata in the database.

methods.name: AttachmentService
methods.description: Constructor initializing paths and repositories, setting up storage directory.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads files for a specific email owned by a user.

methods.name: listByEmail
methods.description: Lists all attachments associated with a specific email for a user.

methods.name: loadForDownload
methods.description: Loads an attachment as a Resource for downloading, if owned by the user.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts an Attachment entity to an AttachmentDto.
